superpowers.mode: Codex skills; no hooks or plugin activation

c-tools.reason: House C style enforcement and C language-server support. clang-format matches system Clang 21.1.8 exactly; 21.1.6 is the newest 21.x clang-tidy wheel published on PyPI.

lsp-tools.reason: Language servers for the official clangd-lsp and pyright-lsp Claude Code plugins; Pyright's wheel bundles its JavaScript and runs on the pinned Node wheel without runtime downloads.

plugins.beads@beads-marketplace: local directory marketplace build/author-tools/sources/beads at the inspected commit
plugins.superpowers@superpowers-dev: local directory marketplace build/author-tools/sources/superpowers at the pinned commit
plugins.clangd-lsp@claude-plugins-official: official marketplace; needs clangd on PATH (--user-lsp-shims)
plugins.pyright-lsp@claude-plugins-official: official marketplace; needs pyright-langserver on PATH (--user-lsp-shims)

claude-code.scope: project (.claude/settings.json); .mcp.json declares only local stdio servers
claude-code.policy: No git, commit or push hooks; no remote MCP servers or code upload.

policy: Author conveniences; curriculum canonical obligations and evidence retain authority. No automatic push, commit, policy change or remote code upload.
